-- Inserir progresso em todos os livros para Jenifer Borges
INSERT INTO student_book_progress (user_id, book_id, progress_percentage, units_completed, total_units, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT 
  u.id,
  1, -- Book 1
  100, -- 100% completo
  12,
  12,
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 MONTH),
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 20 MONTH),
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 MONTH),
  NOW()
FROM users u WHERE u.email = 'jenifer.borges@influx.com.br';
